prs.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle

clusters.pick_reason: #2478 addresses the full exception hierarchy: it introduces a _restore_mcp_error dispatch helper that handles both MCPError (base class) and UrlElicitationRequiredError, routing the latter through its specialised from_error reconstructor to preserve the typed elicitations list. #2555 only adds __reduce__ to UrlElicitationRequiredError and leaves the base MCPError class unfixed, meaning callers that catch and re-raise the base type would still corrupt on pickle. #2478 also removes the spurious '# pragma: no cover' on the data property as a contained cleanup. Both start from identical base state (f153ea319d), so the broader fix in #2478 supersedes #2555.

members.title: fix(shared): preserve MCPError payload on pickle
members.author: MukundaKatta
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Python's default pickle path reconstructs MCPError (and subclasses) by calling cls(*self.args), but self.args holds a plain string (set by super().__init__(error.message)) while the constructors expect typed objects (ErrorData for the base class, an elicitations list for UrlElicitationRequiredError). This causes TypeError on every unpickle. Both PRs branch from the same base commit (f153ea319d) and edit the same lines in src/mcp/shared/exceptions.py, so they conflict on merge. (2 PRs)
